thread:
sarah: 48-hr preflight for Thursday's "Benchmarks & Best Practices" webinar. Quick checklist request: reg page UTM, reminder cadence, Zoom ingest + captions, recording ownership, post-event assets + SLA for HubSpot lead enrichment. Can we run through now?

tom: Reg page: minimal fields (work email, role, company, timezone). Add hidden field `utm_source=launch` and `utm_medium=webinar`. Calendar add should include passcode + dial-in. Keep landing hero short w/ value props + 3 bullets.

anika: Reminder cadence: 48h, 2h, 15m. Use plain-text 2h email with calendar link. 15m should be SMS for registrants who opted in (Twilio zap). Subject lines: 48h: "Reminder: Benchmarks & Best Practices for LLM inference"; 2h: short, 15m: action "Join now".

devops-bot: Zoom checks: cloud recording ON, `auto-transcription` enabled, `waiting room` ON, `join before host` OFF. Set alternative host to tom and panelists list. Auto-recording must be to cloud folder: `Marketing/Webinars/Benchmarks-2067770000`. Also enable `recording disclaimer` popup.

anika: I'll own post-event edit workflow. Timeline: raw cloud -> download by 3pm same day -> captions via Otter -> produce 3 clips (hero 90s, customer quote 45s, demo 2m) by EOD next business day. Deliver to Drive + mark in Asana task `WB-206777`.

sarah: HubSpot lead routing: use `event:benchmarks-apr` tag, set lifecycle stage = lead, enrich via Clearbit webhook. Enterprise domains -> assign `sales-liaison`. Mark registrants who attended > 10 mins as `attended` and send `nurture` sequence otherwise.

sales-liaison: I'll monitor attendees live and follow up with key contacts. Request: add `company_size` hidden dropdown on reg page to help prioritization.

anika: Good call. We can add `company_size` but keep default optional. For tracking add `utm_campaign=benchmarks-apr` to promo links.

sarah: Can someone confirm the Zoom->Drive Zap + Zoom->HubSpot contact creation is set? We had one outage last month where recordings didn't attach.

devops-bot: Zap status: `Zoom->Drive` healthy, `Zoom->HubSpot` has 2 recent retries; recommend manual check pre-webinar. Running manual sync now.

tom: I'll spin up a quick dry run 30m before show time to confirm auto-captions and alt host. Also will test calendar invite passcode and copy dial-in.

anika: Email drafts: post-event send at 2 hours with recording + short TL;DR bullets + CTA to book a demo. Follow-up 3 days later with clips and a case study link. I'll paste templates in `/Marketing/Templates/webinar-posts`.

sarah: Perfect. Final ask: create a #marketing-webinars-live thread for live ops (one pinned message w/ Zoom link + backup RTMP). I'll create that and invite ops + sales-liaison.

sales-liaison: On it. I'll standby for any high-value attendee pushes.

sarah: Thanks all 680 Let's keep slack updates short during the show (time stamps only). If anything goes sideways ping @tom and @devops-bot.
